points.description: States one valid advantage of reservoir routing, e.g. it estimates peak reservoir levels/outflow during a flood, helping design overflow/spillway channels and prevent submergence of nearby areas.
points.partial_credit: Half if vaguely stated (e.g. 'helps in flood control of reservoir') without a clear benefit.

points.description: States one valid advantage of channel flood routing, e.g. it gives the flood hydrograph/duration profile along the channel, helping in design of bridges, transport control, or bank-side development.
points.partial_credit: Half if vaguely stated (e.g. 'helps predict floods downstream') without a clear benefit.

rubric.notes: Full marks: one sensible advantage for each of reservoir routing and channel routing, in any wording. Part marks for an advantage that is on the right track but vague. No marks for a wrong or unrelated statement, or if the two types are swapped without a valid benefit. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
